source.snippet: I had a PowerDNS setup with one primary and one secondary. I added another secondary for redundancy, but can't find a proper way to get the new secondary to synchronize and get all existing zones from the primary. Every solution I found needs you to handle it one zone at a time.

problem_statement: DNS administrators scaling PowerDNS to multiple secondaries have no built-in bulk zone transfer mechanism — every workaround requires manual per-zone handling, creating operational toil proportional to zone count.
target_segment: Sysadmins and DevOps engineers at SMBs or hosting providers managing PowerDNS with 50+ zones
notes: Single data point but represents a recurring class of operational pain at any DNS-heavy org. The 'one zone at a time' limitation implies hours of manual work at scale — clear time cost. Hosting providers and managed DNS resellers are natural paying buyers. A scripted bulk-sync tool or managed service could monetize via one-time sale or subscription. Signal strength kept at 2 due to single source.
